title: Open output folders in foreground
summary: Updates the Windows folder-open path so backend-allowlisted directory opens launch Explorer and request foreground focus for the opened Explorer window.
reason: The operator reported that the Completed page Open Output Folder action opened Explorer behind the app instead of bringing the output folder to the foreground.
behavior_before: Completed output-folder opens resolved the backend-owned path correctly, but the shared Windows shell opener delegated directory targets to os.startfile, which could leave Explorer behind the WebView/Tauri window.
behavior_after: Directory targets still resolve through the existing backend allowlist, then launch Explorer and request foreground focus for a newly visible Explorer window; file opens continue to use the existing default-app behavior.
manual_validation: apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --paths src/mediapipeline/core/files/opening.py tests/python/desktop/test_service_file_open.py - passed (2 written, 0 unchanged)
rollback_plan: Restore directory handling in src/mediapipeline/core/files/opening.py to os.startfile, remove the foreground-focused unit assertion, refresh generated summaries, and rerun the targeted file-open tests.
notes: No media policy, source/scratch/output movement, publish/drain, rename, or frontend command-surface behavior changes.
